items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S2977

SPONSOR: GAUGHRAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act in relation to legalizing, validating, ratifying and confirming a
transportation contract of the Cold Spring Harbor central school
district

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

This bill would correct a clerical error between the Cold Spring Harbor
Central School District and the State Education Department in the 2013-
14 school year.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Legalizes, validates, ratifies, and confirms a transportation
contract, E259217, in connection with a transportation contract of the
201314 school year.

Section 2: Directs the Department of Education to consider the aforemen-
tioned contract for transportation aid.

Section 3: Sets the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This bill seeks to mitigate the negative impact to the Cold Spring
Harbor Central School District, which would lose a major portion of its
State aid due to a clerical error on the part of the district.  Specif-
ically, the error may result in the loss of significant transportation
aid.

Without the restoration of this transportation aid, the school district
would be faced with either cutting the quality and scope of its educa-
tional programs or raising real property taxes dramatically.  This would
place an undue burden on district residents and present hardships to
many in the Cold Spring Harbor community.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2017: S.1313/A.6088

2016: 6.6445/A.10082

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

VETO MESSAGE - No. 130
 
TO THE ASSEMBLY:
 
I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills:
 
Assembly Bill Number A5442, entitled:
 
    "AN ACT to legalize, validate, ratify and confirm the actions of the
      Panama  central  school district notwithstanding failure to timely
      file final building cost reports with the education department"
 
Assembly Bill Number A7228, entitled:
 
    "AN ACT relating to legalizing, validating, ratifying and confirming
      a transportation contract of the Fulton city school district"
 
TO THE SENATE
 
I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills:
 
Senate Bill Number 644-A, entitled:
 
    "AN ACT to validate certain acts of  the  Islip  Union  Free  school
      district with regard to certain capital improvement projects"
 
Senate Bill Number 2976, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT to legalize, ratify and confirm the actions of the Hunting-
      ton union free school  district  notwithstanding  the  failure  to
      timely file final building cost reports with the education depart-
      ment"
 
Senate Bill Number 2977, entitled
 
    "AN  ACT  in  relation  to  legalizing,  validating,  ratifying  and
      confirming a transportation contract of  the  Cold  Spring  Harbor
      central school district"
 
Senate Bill Number 4333, entitled:
 
    "AN ACT to legalize, validate, ratify and confirm the actions of the
      Monticello  central school district notwithstanding the failure to
      timely file final building cost reports with the education depart-
      ment"
 
Senate Bill Number 4949-A, entitled:
 
    "AN ACT to validate certain  acts  of  the  Mahopac  Central  school
      district with regard to certain capital improvement projects"
 
Senate Bill Number 5794-A, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  in  relation  to  authorizing the Liverpool central school
      district to receive state aid for certain approved capital  funded
      projects"
 
Senate Bill Number 6201, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  in  relation  to  legalizing,  validating,  ratifying  and
      confirming certain transportation contracts of  the  Corning  city
      school district"
 
    NOT APPROVED
 
  Each of these bills would authorize, outside of the State budget proc-
ess,  payment  of  State  expense-based  education aid above the amounts
calculated and previously agreed to under current law.
 
  These bills would forgive the return of State  building  aid  payments
from  the  Islip  Union  Free School District, the Huntington Union Free
School District, the Monticello Central  School  District,  and  Mahopac
Central  School District, the Liverpool Central School District, and the
Panama Central School District, and would reverse disallowance of  State
transportation  aid  payments  to  the Cold Spring Harbor Central School
District, the Corning City School District, and the Fulton  City  School
District.  The  payments  withheld  or  to be recovered for these school
districts each resulted from violation of State laws that were known  to
the  districts  at  the  time,  and related to the districts' failure to
properly obtain authorization for expenses reimbursable by the State.
 
  In both the 2017 and 2018 State Budgets, the Legislature and I  agreed
to  payment provisions to mitigate significant outstanding filing penal-
ties for some of these school districts. As well, some of  these  school
districts have benefitted from special legislation adopted in the budget
to  extend the payback period for their respective penalties, and others
have received legislative aid through the budget to  offset  the  penal-
ties.

  I have vetoed several similar bills in the past due to their financial
impacts  outside  of the State budget process. Bills of this nature have
infrequently been signed, and are signed only due to extenuating circum-
stances.
 
  However, these bills do not present unique  circumstances,  and  would
create  new  financial  obligations not accounted for within the State's
financial plan. Such  funding  decisions  should  be  addressed  in  the
context  of  the  annual  budget  negotiations.  These  bills would also
violate existing agreements that were  previously  negotiated  with  the
Legislature  during  the  budget  negotiation  process.  I  am therefore
constrained to veto these bills.
 
  These bills are disapproved.                (signed) ANDREW M. CUOMO
 
                               __________
